meta.description: General terms and conditions of Hormonexperten for medical remote treatment by video consultation.

sections.title: § 1 Scope of application and provider
body: These General Terms and Conditions (GTC) apply to all contracts for medical remote treatment between:
(hereinafter the “Physician” or “Hormonexperten”)
and her patients (hereinafter the “Patient”).
These GTC apply, together with the Terms of Use for Remote Treatment, to:

list: all medical remote treatments via video consultation
consultations in the field of bioidentical hormone therapy and thyroid counselling
the issuing of prescriptions and medical documentation
all services booked via the website www.hormonexperten.de or via our online booking portal

body: Important: The Terms of Use for Remote Treatment contain the medical information on hormone therapy (including risks, monitoring obligations and patient obligations) and form an integral part of these GTC. Both documents together form the contractual basis.
All services are provided exclusively on a self-pay basis. The Patient is the sole contracting party and debtor.
Billing with health insurers:

list: Billing via statutory health insurance (GKV) is not possible.
Billing via private health insurance (PKV) is only possible using analogous GOÄ codes. Reimbursement by the PKV cannot be guaranteed.

body: It is solely the Patient’s responsibility to clarify any reimbursement with their insurer before concluding the contract.
At the time of booking, the Patient must be at least 18 years old and have full legal capacity to enter into a binding treatment contract.
Treatment with bioidentical hormones is provided exclusively to adults (18 and over). Minors cannot be treated.

sections.title: § 2 Conclusion of contract
body: The presentation of services on the website is not a binding offer, but an invitation to the Patient to submit a binding offer.
The contract is concluded as follows:

list: The Patient opens the online booking portal via the “Book now” button on the website and selects the desired service and an appointment.
The Patient accepts these GTC and the Terms of Use for Remote Treatment by ticking the corresponding checkbox.
By clicking the button “TODO: exact button label in the Pabau portal, e.g. Book and pay”, the Patient submits a binding offer and pays the fee for the booked service.
The Physician confirms the appointment by email (acceptance of the contract).

body: The treatment contract is concluded upon confirmation of the appointment.
The contract language is German only. Translations of these GTC are provided for information; in case of doubt, the German version prevails.

body.heading: § 2.4 Suitability assessment and refusal of treatment

body: For each request, the Physician assesses whether remote treatment is medically suitable and justifiable. The Physician reserves the right to refuse treatment if:

list: remote treatment is not indicated and an in-person examination is medically required
the requested treatment lies outside the Physician’s field of expertise
the Patient fails to provide required preliminary examinations or laboratory results

body: In the event of refusal, the Patient receives a written explanation and, where applicable, a recommendation for further steps (e.g. preliminary examinations or consultation with another specialist). Fees already paid for services not provided are refunded.
The Physician will make every reasonable effort to provide treatment by remote consultation where medically justifiable. Refusals are made solely for medical or legal reasons.

sections.title: § 3 Description of services
body: TODO: align the services, durations and prices in § 3 with the pricing page (Basic Medical Support €380, Intensive Medical Support €499, as on the old costs page) and the services set up in Pabau.

list: Initial medical history (60-minute video consultation) with analysis of findings and symptoms
Follow-up consultation to discuss laboratory results and establish the therapy plan
Organisation of the first order and prescription of hormones
4 video follow-ups (20 minutes each) within the first 3 months
Validity: 6 months from the start of therapy

body: Not included: follow-up prescriptions when dosage adjustments are required.
Ideal for: women who wish to start bioidentical hormone therapy easily and value regular feedback.
Includes all services of the Hormone Starter Package, plus:

list: 6 instead of 4 video follow-ups (20 minutes each) within the first 6 months
organisation and prescription of follow-up orders for 6 months
additional micronutrient and lifestyle counselling (60 minutes)
Validity: 6 months from the start of therapy

body: Not included: questions and advice by email or phone.
Ideal for: women who want to start bioidentical hormone therapy easily and enhance results through additional counselling.
Includes all services of the Hormone Comfort Package, plus:

list: unlimited email and SMS contact via a dedicated number (during consultation hours only)

body: Minimum term: 3 months. Cancellable monthly with 14 days’ notice. Payable monthly in advance.
Ideal for women with complex hormonal issues (e.g. heavy bleeding, oestrogen dominance, fibroids, fertility concerns, hair loss, hot flushes, mood disturbances, osteoporosis, brain fog).
Fair use policy: Unlimited email and SMS contact is intended for medically meaningful therapeutic support. Reasonable use generally means:

list: up to 10 medical inquiries per month
response within 48 hours on working days
no medical emergencies (these require immediate local medical care)
no excessive use that disadvantages other patients

body: In the event of significant overuse or misuse (e.g. more than 20 inquiries per month or several contacts a day), the Physician reserves the right to:

list: inform the Patient in writing about appropriate use
charge additional inquiries at the regular individual rate (€45 per video consultation)
in extreme cases, terminate the contract without notice (see § 10.4)

body: All initial consultations serve to get acquainted and to give an initial assessment of the individual situation. An in-depth consultation clarifies whether bioidentical hormone therapy is appropriate and which next steps are advisable.
Introductory consultation to assess whether supplementary hormone therapy after pregnancy may be suitable, for symptoms such as:

list: absent menstruation, weight gain, mood swings
loss of libido or energy after childbirth

body: Services include:
Recommended next step: Hormone Starter Package for 6-month therapy support.
Many women aged 35 and over experience hormonal changes despite regular menstruation and unremarkable gynaecological findings.
Services include:

list: analysis even with normal laboratory values
early detection of deficiencies to maintain balance

body: Recommended next step: Hormone Starter Package.
Comprehensive medical history with analysis of existing findings, preparation checklists and organisation of blood sampling.
Suitable for:

list: women and men with hormonal complaints
men seeking natural, bioidentical hormone supplementation instead of potency medication

body: Recommended next step: Hormone Starter Package.
Individual, detailed medical history with analysis of findings, comprehensive symptom assessment and organisation of blood sampling (including digital referral by email).
Suitable for:

list: women on thyroid medication without improvement
weight gain, hair loss, fatigue, digestive issues
Short video consultation (€45, approx. 20 minutes): for patients already in therapy who need a new prescription or a dosage adjustment.
Follow-up consultation (€90, approx. 30 minutes): review of current laboratory results, therapy adjustment, initial prescription and hormone ordering.
Laboratory costs: charged separately at actual cost
Hormone costs: approx. €1.00–€1.50 per day (individually compounded by the pharmacy)
Free of charge: initial suitability inquiry by email, appointment scheduling, administrative questions
Chargeable: medical consultations outside booked packages are only possible within video consultations (see § 13.4)

sections.title: § 4 Prices and payment terms
body: All stated prices are final prices. Billing is carried out in accordance with the German Medical Fee Schedule (GOÄ). As certain modern treatment methods are not explicitly listed in the GOÄ (1982/1999), analogous fee codes are applied pursuant to § 6(2) GOÄ.

Taking into account the complexity, time required and specialised expertise in bioidentical hormone therapy, fee multipliers of 5.0 to 7.0 are agreed pursuant to § 2(1) and (2) GOÄ (deviating agreement), justified by:

list: individualised therapy concepts based on extensive laboratory diagnostics
time-intensive medical histories and follow-up monitoring
remote treatment with increased coordination effort

body: By accepting these GTC, the Patient expressly agrees to this deviating agreement.

The fee for a booked appointment or package is due at booking and is paid in full through the online booking portal. For the Hormone Premium Package, the monthly fee is due in advance at the start of each month. Laboratory costs and other services invoiced separately are due within 14 days of the invoice date without deduction.
Payment at booking is made by Visa, Mastercard, Diners Club, SEPA or Klarna. Invoices issued separately are paid by bank transfer. Other payment methods may be agreed in individual cases.
In the event of default, interest of 8 percentage points above the applicable base interest rate will be charged. The following reminder fees apply:
If invoices are outstanding, the Physician reserves the right to suspend further appointments until they are settled in full.
The Patient’s right of retention with respect to medical services is excluded.
For more extensive treatments, a cost estimate is provided on request.

sections.title: § 5 Appointments and cancellations
body: Appointments are booked through the online booking portal (link “Book now” on the website) or by phone.

lines: Appointments must be cancelled or rescheduled at least 48 hours before the scheduled time, through the patient portal or by email to
. If an appointment is cancelled in time, the fee paid is refunded in full or credited to a new appointment, at the Patient’s choice.

body: If an appointment is not cancelled in time or not attended, the fee for the reserved time slot is retained in full, unless the slot can be given to another patient.
In proven emergencies or unavoidable events (e.g. sudden serious illness with a medical certificate), the fee may be refunded in individual cases as a gesture of goodwill.
If technical problems on the Physician’s side prevent the appointment, a replacement appointment is offered free of charge.

sections.title: § 6 Remote treatment and technical requirements
body: Video consultations take place via the video function of our practice software Pabau. The Patient receives the access link in the appointment confirmation and in the patient portal.
The Patient must ensure:

list: a stable internet connection (at least 2 Mbit/s)
a current web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge)
a quiet, uninterrupted and confidential environment

body: The Patient is informed that:

list: remote treatment cannot fully replace a physical examination
certain complaints may require an in-person examination
in emergencies, local emergency services must be contacted immediately
the Physician may refer the Patient to local specialists if necessary

body: The Patient is responsible for their own technical equipment and internet connection.
If the Patient is late, the Physician waits a maximum of 5 minutes. After that, the appointment is forfeited and treated as not attended.

sections.title: § 7 Data protection
body: Personal and medical data are processed exclusively in compliance with the GDPR and medical confidentiality.
All video consultations are transmitted in encrypted form.
Medical records are kept for 10 years in accordance with statutory retention periods.
The Patient has the right to:

list: erasure (where no statutory retention obligations apply)

body: Video consultations are not recorded as a matter of principle. Recording only takes place with the Patient’s explicit written consent and solely for documentation purposes.

lines: More information on data protection is in our

sections.title: § 8 Limitation of liability
body: Medical advice and therapy recommendations are given to the best of knowledge and belief, based on the information supplied by the Patient. The quality and accuracy of advice depend significantly on the completeness and truthfulness of that information.

body.heading: § 8.2 Patient responsibility and exclusion of liability

body: Carrying out recommended measures, particularly correct intake of medication or supplements and lifestyle changes, is the Patient’s responsibility. The Physician cannot monitor compliance.

Liability for damage to health or other harm resulting from incorrect use, unauthorised changes or discontinuation of therapy by the Patient is excluded. No liability is assumed for consequences of incomplete, incorrect or late information from the Patient.
The Physician is under no circumstances liable for indirect damage, including consequential damage, loss of profit or other indirect financial losses.

Patients are thoroughly informed about treatments and recommended preparations. Side effects cannot be completely ruled out for every individual. No liability is assumed for the safety or tolerability of preparations compounded by external pharmacies or other pharmaceutical products.

body.heading: § 8.3 Limitation of liability for slight negligence

body: Except in cases of intent or gross negligence, liability is limited to breach of essential contractual obligations (cardinal obligations). In cases of slight negligence, liability is limited to foreseeable damage typical for this type of contract.

No liability is assumed for failures or disruptions of the video platform, data transmission problems or other technical impairments outside the Physician’s responsibility, in particular those caused by internet providers, patient devices or third-party platforms.
The above exclusions do not apply where mandatory statutory liability applies, in particular for culpable injury to life, body or health, or under product liability law.
The Physician holds appropriate professional liability insurance in accordance with professional regulations. Details are available on request.
The Physician is not liable for delays, failures or impossibility of performance due to events beyond reasonable control, including:

list: failure of telecommunications networks or the internet
failure or disruption of the video platform or the booking system

body: Legal consequences:

list: a free replacement appointment where possible
refund of prepaid fees for services not provided in case of permanent impossibility
no further liability (e.g. compensation for lost benefits)

sections.title: § 9 Right of withdrawal

body.heading: § 9.1 Exclusion of the right of withdrawal

body: The right of withdrawal does not apply to contracts for health services where the service has been fully provided and performance began only after the Patient gave explicit consent and acknowledged that they lose the right of withdrawal on full performance (TODO: correct legal citation, see agb-review.md item A6; old text cited § 312g(2) No. 9 BGB).
The Patient is expressly informed of the exclusion of the right of withdrawal before the contract is concluded.

sections.title: § 10 Term and termination
body: Individual appointments end when the booked service has been provided.

list: The Hormone Starter and Hormone Comfort packages are valid for 6 months from the start of therapy.
Unused services expire at the end of the validity period.
Notice period: 14 days to the end of the month
Cancellation must be in text form (email is sufficient)

body: The right to terminate for good cause remains unaffected. Good cause includes in particular:

list: false information on medically relevant facts
persistent misuse of unlimited contact in the Premium Package despite a written warning (see § 3.1.3)

body: If the contract is terminated for good cause attributable to the Patient, no refund is made. If attributable to the Physician, fees are refunded pro rata.

sections.title: § 11 Applicable law and jurisdiction
body: The law of the Republic of Cyprus applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. EU consumer protection rights remain unaffected.

For disputes with Patients who are consumers residing in an EU member state, the courts at the Patient’s place of residence have jurisdiction in accordance with mandatory consumer protection law. The Patient may also sue before the courts of Pyla, Cyprus.
For all other cases, the exclusive place of jurisdiction is Pyla, Cyprus.
For EU consumers, the mandatory consumer protection provisions of their country of residence apply.
The parties are generally willing to attempt out-of-court dispute resolution before going to court. Participation is voluntary and does not affect the right to go to court at any time.

sections.title: § 12 Medical information and Terms of Use

body.heading: § 12.1 Terms of Use for Remote Treatment

lines: Detailed medical information on bioidentical hormone therapy, including risks, contraindications, monitoring obligations and patient duties, is set out in the

lines.label: Terms of Use for Remote Treatment

lines: , which form an integral part of these GTC.

body: By accepting these GTC, the Patient also accepts the Terms of Use for Remote Treatment in full. Both documents together form the binding basis for treatment.
The Patient undertakes in particular to:

list: before therapy: have a current gynaecological (women) or urological (men) examination
during therapy: attend annual follow-up examinations
documentation: upload examination results to the patient portal
medical history: provide complete and truthful information
therapy request: confirm the wish for therapy despite the risks explained

body: Failure to comply may lead to termination of treatment and may affect the Physician’s insurance cover.
By booking an appointment, the Patient expressly confirms:

list: having read and understood the medical information
explicitly wishing to proceed with bioidentical hormone therapy despite the risks

sections.title: § 13 Final provisions
body: If any provision of these GTC is or becomes invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain valid.
Amendments and additions to these GTC require text form. This also applies to any amendment of this clause.
The current version of these GTC is available at www.hormonexperten.de.
Note: medical questions can only be answered within booked video consultations. Medical advice is not given by email.
